messages.title: VSC Complete
messages.text:
Field VSC pass 1: corrections written to camFile_VSC/ and set in config.json. The residual no 3-D move explains: robust SD 0.724 -> 0.592 px. The 2-D tolerance is left at 1.5 px. On the tube run T1 the correction paid at 1.0 px (two passes: +11 % real long tracks, a fifth fewer ghosts) and changed nothing at 1.5 px, so consider 1.0 px, set in the tracking settings (or objects[0].ipr.tol_2d_px in config.json). Rerun tracking with the corrected cameras, then VSC again for a second pass (two or three passes).

Log saved to VSC_log.txt
